# Cal.com MCP Server: tools

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-tools-md.ts from the registered tools. Do not edit by hand; run `npm run docs:tools`. -->

39 tools. The connection's access level decides which ones a client sees:

| Access level | Tools | What it adds |
|---|---|---|
| `read` (default) | 17 | Everything read-only: profile, bookings, availability, calendars, event types, schedules, video apps, webhooks |
| `bookings` | 28 | Booking actions (create, reschedule, cancel, confirm, decline, no-show, guests, location) and private links |
| `full` | 39 | Configuration: event types, schedules, profile, default video app, webhooks |

Destructive tools refuse to run until the model passes `confirm: true`, which it should only do after you agree. Times are read and shown in your Cal profile time zone unless a tool gets `time_zone`. Tools that return data accept `format`: `markdown` (default) or `json`.

## Profile & diagnostics

### `hello`

**Hello** · access `read` · read-only

Check that the Cal.com MCP server is reachable and see how this connection is configured (no API call).

_No parameters._

### `get_instance_info`

**Connection diagnostics** · access `read` · read-only

Diagnose the Cal connection: whether the API v2 URL is reachable (and is really API v2), whether the API key works, the account it belongs to, event types, default schedule, connected calendars, default video app, rate-limit headroom and which tool groups are enabled. Use it first when other tools fail.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | `markdown` \| `json` | No | Output format: "markdown" (default, readable) or "json" (structured data). |

### `get_my_profile`

**My Cal profile** · access `read` · read-only

Your Cal profile: name, username, email, time zone, week start, 12/24-hour clock and default availability schedule.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | `markdown` \| `json` | No | Output format: "markdown" (default, readable) or "json" (structured data). |

### `update_my_profile`

**Update my profile** · access `full` · changes data (safe to repeat)

Change your Cal profile: name, time zone, week start, 12/24-hour clock, language, bio or default schedule.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | No |  |
| `time_zone` | string | No | IANA time zone, e.g. "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur". |
| `week_start` | `Monday` \| `Tuesday` \| `Wednesday` \| `Thursday` \| `Friday` \| `Saturday` \| `Sunday` | No |  |
| `time_format` | `12` \| `24` | No | 12 or 24. |
| `locale` | string | No | Language code, e.g. "en", "ms", "id". |
| `bio` | string | No |  |
| `default_schedule_id` | integer | No | Schedule id (list_schedules) to make your default. |

## Bookings

### `list_bookings`

**List bookings** · access `read` · read-only

List bookings as an agenda grouped by day in your time zone. Default: upcoming bookings (including ones waiting for confirmation or payment). Use when= for today / this_week / past / cancelled / a custom range, and filter by attendee or event type. Each line shows the booking uid used by the other booking tools.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `when` | `upcoming` \| `unconfirmed` \| `past` \| `cancelled` \| `today` \| `tomorrow` \| `yesterday` \| `this_week` \| `next_week` \| `last_week` \| `next_7_days` \| `next_30_days` \| `past_7_days` \| `past_30_days` \| `this_month` \| `last_month` \| `custom` | No | upcoming (default) · unconfirmed (waiting for your confirmation or for payment) · past · cancelled · a date range preset · custom (with from/to). |
| `from` | string | No | when="custom": start date "YYYY-MM-DD" or datetime, in time_zone. |
| `to` | string | No | when="custom": end date (inclusive) or datetime. Default: same day as from. |
| `status` | `upcoming` \| `recurring` \| `past` \| `cancelled` \| `unconfirmed`[] | No | Override Cal's status filter (OR-combined). Usually leave empty and use when. |
| `include_cancelled` | boolean | No | Date ranges only: also show cancelled / declined bookings (default false). |
| `attendee_email` | string | No | Only bookings with this attendee email. |
| `attendee_name` | string | No | Only bookings with an attendee of this name. |
| `event_type_id` | integer | No | Only bookings of this event type (id from list_event_types). |
| `sort` | `asc` \| `desc` | No | Order by start time. Default: asc, or desc for past / cancelled. |
| `limit` | integer | No | Maximum bookings to return (default 50). |
| `offset` | integer | No | Skip this many bookings (pagination). |
| `time_zone` | string | No | IANA time zone used to read and show times, e.g. "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur". Default: the time zone in your Cal profile. |
| `format` | `markdown` \| `json` | No | Output format: "markdown" (default, readable) or "json" (structured data). |

### `get_booking`

**Get a booking** · access `read` · read-only

Full details of one booking (or every occurrence of a recurring series): time, status, attendees, guests, location / meeting link, booking-form answers, cancellation or reschedule info. Optionally include attendee ids, add-to-calendar links, calendar references, Cal Video recordings, transcripts and meeting sessions.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `booking_uid` | string | No | Booking uid, as shown by list_bookings / get_booking (e.g. "8bx2PqLmZt0aQd71"). |
| `seat_uid` | string | No | For seated events: look the booking up by seat uid instead. |
| `include` | `attendees` \| `calendar_links` \| `references` \| `recordings` \| `transcripts` \| `conferencing_sessions`[] | No | Extra data to fetch alongside the booking. |
| `time_zone` | string | No | IANA time zone used to read and show times, e.g. "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur". Default: the time zone in your Cal profile. |
| `format` | `markdown` \| `json` | No | Output format: "markdown" (default, readable) or "json" (structured data). |

### `get_booking_summary`

**Booking summary** · access `read` · read-only

Statistics for a period, computed from your bookings (Cal.diy has no Insights page): bookings by status and event type, booked hours, cancellations and their reasons, no-shows, busiest weekdays and hours, top and repeat attendees, and estimated revenue from paid event types — compared with the previous period by default.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `period` | `this_week` \| `last_week` \| `this_month` \| `last_month` \| `past_7_days` \| `past_30_days` \| `past_90_days` \| `this_year` \| `last_year` \| `next_7_days` \| `next_30_days` \| `custom` | No | Default past_30_days. "custom" needs from / to. |
| `from` | string | No | period="custom": start date "YYYY-MM-DD". |
| `to` | string | No | period="custom": end date (inclusive). |
| `event_type_id` | integer | No | Only this event type. |
| `compare_previous` | boolean | No | Compare with the previous period of the same length (default true). |
| `time_zone` | string | No | IANA time zone used to read and show times, e.g. "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur". Default: the time zone in your Cal profile. |
| `format` | `markdown` \| `json` | No | Output format: "markdown" (default, readable) or "json" (structured data). |

### `create_booking`

**Create a booking** · access `bookings` · changes data

Book someone into one of your event types. Cal sends the confirmation emails and calendar invites as for a normal booking. By default the time is first checked against open slots (get_available_slots); if it is not open, nearby open times are returned instead of booking. link / address / phone locations use what the event type defines — to give one booking its own link, book it and then call update_booking_location.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `event_type_id` | integer | No | Event type id (list_event_types). Or use event_type_slug. |
| `event_type_slug` | string | No | Event type slug, e.g. "30min". |
| `username` | string | No | Owner of event_type_slug when it is not you. |
| `start` | string | Yes | Start time: "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm" (wall time in time_zone) or ISO with offset, e.g. "2026-10-27T15:00:00+08:00". |
| `time_zone` | string | No | IANA time zone used to read and show times, e.g. "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur". Default: the time zone in your Cal profile. |
| `attendee` | { name, email, time_zone, phone, language } | Yes | The person being booked. |
| `guests` | string[] | No | Extra guest emails to invite. |
| `location` | { type, value, public } | No | Which of the event type's locations to use. Default: the event type's first location. |
| `length_in_minutes` | integer | No | For event types with several lengths: the length to book. |
| `notes` | string | No | Additional notes shown on the booking (the "notes" field). |
| `booking_fields` | object | No | Answers to custom booking questions, keyed by field slug (see get_event_type). |
| `metadata` | object | No | Up to 50 string key/values stored on the booking. |
| `recurrence_count` | integer | No | Recurring event types: number of occurrences to book (default: the event type setting). |
| `check_availability` | boolean | No | Check the time against open slots first (default true). |
| `allow_unpaid` | boolean | No | Paid event types: create the booking even though no payment is collected (default false). |

### `reschedule_booking`

**Reschedule a booking** · access `bookings` · changes data

Move a booking to a new time. The new time is checked against open slots first (unless check_availability is false). Cal creates a new booking with a new uid and notifies everyone.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `booking_uid` | string | Yes | Booking uid, as shown by list_bookings / get_booking (e.g. "8bx2PqLmZt0aQd71"). |
| `start` | string | Yes | New start: "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm" (wall time in time_zone) or ISO with offset. |
| `time_zone` | string | No | IANA time zone used to read and show times, e.g. "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur". Default: the time zone in your Cal profile. |
| `reason` | string | No | Reason shown to the attendees. |
| `rescheduled_by` | string | No | Email of who is rescheduling — needed for event types that require confirmation (the owner email skips re-confirmation). |
| `seat_uid` | string | No | Seated events: move only this seat. |
| `check_availability` | boolean | No | Check the new time against open slots first (default true). |

### `cancel_booking`

**Cancel a booking** · access `bookings` · destructive — needs `confirm: true`

Cancel a booking; Cal notifies the attendees. Needs confirm: true after the user agrees.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `booking_uid` | string | Yes | Booking uid, as shown by list_bookings / get_booking (e.g. "8bx2PqLmZt0aQd71"). |
| `reason` | string | No | Cancellation reason shown to the attendees. |
| `cancel_subsequent` | boolean | No | Recurring bookings: also cancel every later occurrence. |
| `seat_uid` | string | No | Seated events: cancel only this seat. |
| `confirm` | boolean | No | Must be true. Set it only after the user has explicitly confirmed this action. |
| `time_zone` | string | No | IANA time zone used to read and show times, e.g. "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur". Default: the time zone in your Cal profile. |

### `confirm_booking`

**Confirm a booking request** · access `bookings` · changes data (safe to repeat)

Accept a booking that is waiting for your confirmation (list_bookings when="unconfirmed"). Bookings of paid event types that are still waiting for payment are refused unless allow_unpaid is true.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `booking_uid` | string | Yes | Booking uid, as shown by list_bookings / get_booking (e.g. "8bx2PqLmZt0aQd71"). |
| `allow_unpaid` | boolean | No | Confirm a booking of a paid event type that is still waiting for payment (default false). |
| `time_zone` | string | No | IANA time zone used to read and show times, e.g. "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur". Default: the time zone in your Cal profile. |

### `decline_booking`

**Decline a booking request** · access `bookings` · destructive — needs `confirm: true`

Reject a booking that is waiting for your confirmation; the attendee is notified. Needs confirm: true.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `booking_uid` | string | Yes | Booking uid, as shown by list_bookings / get_booking (e.g. "8bx2PqLmZt0aQd71"). |
| `reason` | string | No | Reason sent to the attendee. |
| `confirm` | boolean | No | Must be true. Set it only after the user has explicitly confirmed this action. |
| `time_zone` | string | No | IANA time zone used to read and show times, e.g. "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur". Default: the time zone in your Cal profile. |

### `mark_no_show`

**Mark no-show** · access `bookings` · changes data (safe to repeat)

Record that the host and/or attendees did not show up to a past booking (or undo it with absent: false).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `booking_uid` | string | Yes | Booking uid, as shown by list_bookings / get_booking (e.g. "8bx2PqLmZt0aQd71"). |
| `host_absent` | boolean | No | true if you (the host) did not attend. |
| `attendees` | { email, absent }[] | No | Attendees to mark, by email. |
| `time_zone` | string | No | IANA time zone used to read and show times, e.g. "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur". Default: the time zone in your Cal profile. |

### `add_booking_guests`

**Add guests to a booking** · access `bookings` · changes data

Invite up to 10 more people to an existing booking; Cal emails them the invite and updates the calendar event.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `booking_uid` | string | Yes | Booking uid, as shown by list_bookings / get_booking (e.g. "8bx2PqLmZt0aQd71"). |
| `guests` | { email, name, time_zone, phone }[] | Yes | Guests to add. |
| `time_zone` | string | No | IANA time zone used to read and show times, e.g. "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur". Default: the time zone in your Cal profile. |

### `remove_booking_attendee`

**Remove an attendee** · access `bookings` · destructive — needs `confirm: true`

Remove an attendee or guest from a booking (they receive a cancellation email). The primary attendee cannot be removed — cancel the booking instead. Needs confirm: true.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `booking_uid` | string | Yes | Booking uid, as shown by list_bookings / get_booking (e.g. "8bx2PqLmZt0aQd71"). |
| `attendee_id` | integer | No | Attendee id (get_booking with include=["attendees"]). |
| `attendee_email` | string | No | Or the attendee email. |
| `confirm` | boolean | No | Must be true. Set it only after the user has explicitly confirmed this action. |

### `update_booking_location`

**Change booking location** · access `bookings` · changes data (safe to repeat)

Change where a booking happens — a video app, a specific meeting link, an address or a phone number. Cal updates the calendar event.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `booking_uid` | string | Yes | Booking uid, as shown by list_bookings / get_booking (e.g. "8bx2PqLmZt0aQd71"). |
| `location` | { type, value, public } | Yes | The new location. link / address / phone need value here. |
| `time_zone` | string | No | IANA time zone used to read and show times, e.g. "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur". Default: the time zone in your Cal profile. |

## Availability & calendars

### `get_available_slots`

**Available slots** · access `read` · read-only

Open booking times for an event type, as a compact list per day in your time zone (or time_zone). Default range: the next 7 days. Use it before create_booking or reschedule_booking, or to answer "when am I free?".

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `event_type_id` | integer | No | Event type id (list_event_types). Or use event_type_slug. |
| `event_type_slug` | string | No | Event type slug, e.g. "30min". |
| `username` | string | No | Owner of event_type_slug when it is not you. |
| `start` | string | No | First day "YYYY-MM-DD" (or a datetime) in time_zone. Default: today. |
| `end` | string | No | Last day "YYYY-MM-DD" (inclusive) or a datetime. Default: start + days - 1. |
| `days` | integer | No | Number of days when end is not given (default 7). |
| `duration` | integer | No | For event types with several lengths: the length in minutes. |
| `booking_uid_to_reschedule` | string | No | When rescheduling: the booking uid, so its current time counts as free. |
| `time_zone` | string | No | IANA time zone used to read and show times, e.g. "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur". Default: the time zone in your Cal profile. |
| `format` | `markdown` \| `json` | No | Output format: "markdown" (default, readable) or "json" (structured data). |

### `list_calendars`

**Connected calendars** · access `read` · read-only

Calendars connected to Cal (Google, Office 365, Apple, CalDAV …): which ones are checked for conflicts and where new bookings are written. Shows the credential ids and external ids used by get_busy_times.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | `markdown` \| `json` | No | Output format: "markdown" (default, readable) or "json" (structured data). |

### `get_busy_times`

**Busy times** · access `read` · read-only

Busy blocks from your connected calendars for a date range (default: the next 7 days) — every calendar that is checked for conflicts unless you pass specific calendars. Works for Google, Office 365, Apple and CalDAV.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `start` | string | No | First day "YYYY-MM-DD". Default: today. |
| `end` | string | No | Last day (inclusive). Default: start + 6 days. |
| `calendars` | { credential_id, external_id }[] | No | Specific calendars (ids from list_calendars). Default: all calendars checked for conflicts. |
| `time_zone` | string | No | IANA time zone used to read and show times, e.g. "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur". Default: the time zone in your Cal profile. |
| `format` | `markdown` \| `json` | No | Output format: "markdown" (default, readable) or "json" (structured data). |

### `list_calendar_events`

**Google Calendar events** · access `read` · read-only

Events on your connected Google Calendar for a date range (default: the next 7 days), including events not booked through Cal. Google Calendar only (Cal API limitation).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `start` | string | No | First day "YYYY-MM-DD". Default: today. |
| `end` | string | No | Last day (inclusive). Default: start + 6 days. |
| `calendar_id` | string | No | External calendar id from list_calendars. Default: your primary calendar. |
| `time_zone` | string | No | IANA time zone used to read and show times, e.g. "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur". Default: the time zone in your Cal profile. |
| `format` | `markdown` \| `json` | No | Output format: "markdown" (default, readable) or "json" (structured data). |

## Event types & private links

### `list_event_types`

**List event types** · access `read` · read-only

Your event types (meeting types people can book) with id, length, price, visibility, confirmation rule, locations and booking page URL.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | `markdown` \| `json` | No | Output format: "markdown" (default, readable) or "json" (structured data). |

### `get_event_type`

**Get an event type** · access `read` · read-only

All settings of one event type in plain language: length, locations, notice, buffers, booking window, limits, confirmation, seats, recurrence and the booking-form questions.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `event_type_id` | integer | Yes | Event type id, as shown by list_event_types. |
| `format` | `markdown` \| `json` | No | Output format: "markdown" (default, readable) or "json" (structured data). |

### `create_event_type`

**Create an event type** · access `full` · changes data

Create a new bookable event type. Common settings have friendly parameters; anything else from the Cal API (booking questions, recurrence, colours …) can go in advanced.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | Yes | Name shown to bookers, e.g. "Strategy session". |
| `slug` | string | No | URL slug, e.g. "strategy-session". Default (create): derived from the title. |
| `length_in_minutes` | integer | Yes | Default length in minutes. |
| `length_options` | integer[] | No | Let bookers choose a length, e.g. [30, 60]. Must include length_in_minutes. |
| `description` | string | No | Description shown on the booking page. |
| `locations` | { type, value, public }[] | No | Where the meeting happens (replaces existing locations). Default for new event types: Cal Video. |
| `minimum_notice_minutes` | integer | No | Minimum minutes between booking and start. |
| `buffer_before_minutes` | integer | No | Blocked minutes before each booking. |
| `buffer_after_minutes` | integer | No | Blocked minutes after each booking. |
| `slot_interval_minutes` | integer | No | Show a start time every N minutes (default: the length). |
| `schedule_id` | integer | No | Availability schedule to use (list_schedules). Default: your default schedule. |
| `hidden` | boolean | No | Hide from your public profile page (the link still works). |
| `requires_confirmation` | boolean | No | Bookings must be confirmed by you before they are final. |
| `seats_per_slot` | integer | No | Seats per time slot for group sessions; 0 turns seats off. |
| `booking_window_days` | integer | No | How many calendar days ahead people can book (rolling); 0 = no limit. |
| `max_bookings_per_day` | integer | No | Maximum bookings of this type per day; 0 = no limit. |
| `disable_guests` | boolean | No | Stop bookers from adding guests. |
| `success_redirect_url` | string | No | Redirect bookers to this URL after booking. |
| `advanced` | object | No | Any other Cal API v2 event type fields (2024-06-14 schema) passed through as-is, e.g. {"bookingFields": [...], "recurrence": {"interval": 1, "occurrences": 4, "frequency": "weekly"}}. |

| `locations` | { type, value, public }[] | No | Where the meeting happens (replaces existing locations). Default for new event types: Cal Video. |
| `minimum_notice_minutes` | integer | No | Minimum minutes between booking and start. |
| `buffer_before_minutes` | integer | No | Blocked minutes before each booking. |
| `buffer_after_minutes` | integer | No | Blocked minutes after each booking. |
| `slot_interval_minutes` | integer | No | Show a start time every N minutes (default: the length). |
| `schedule_id` | integer | No | Availability schedule to use (list_schedules). Default: your default schedule. |
| `hidden` | boolean | No | Hide from your public profile page (the link still works). |
| `requires_confirmation` | boolean | No | Bookings must be confirmed by you before they are final. |
| `seats_per_slot` | integer | No | Seats per time slot for group sessions; 0 turns seats off. |
| `booking_window_days` | integer | No | How many calendar days ahead people can book (rolling); 0 = no limit. |
| `max_bookings_per_day` | integer | No | Maximum bookings of this type per day; 0 = no limit. |
| `disable_guests` | boolean | No | Stop bookers from adding guests. |
| `success_redirect_url` | string | No | Redirect bookers to this URL after booking. |
| `advanced` | object | No | Any other Cal API v2 event type fields (2024-06-14 schema) passed through as-is, e.g. {"bookingFields": [...], "recurrence": {"interval": 1, "occurrences": 4, "frequency": "weekly"}}. |

### `delete_event_type`

**Delete an event type** · access `full` · destructive — needs `confirm: true`

Delete an event type. Existing bookings stay, but its booking link stops working. Needs confirm: true.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `event_type_id` | integer | Yes | Event type id, as shown by list_event_types. |
| `confirm` | boolean | No | Must be true. Set it only after the user has explicitly confirmed this action. |

### `list_private_links`

**List private links** · access `read` · read-only

Private (single-use or expiring) booking links of an event type, with usage and expiry.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `event_type_id` | integer | Yes | Event type id, as shown by list_event_types. |
| `time_zone` | string | No | IANA time zone used to read and show times, e.g. "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur". Default: the time zone in your Cal profile. |
| `format` | `markdown` \| `json` | No | Output format: "markdown" (default, readable) or "json" (structured data). |

### `create_private_link`

**Create a private link** · access `bookings` · changes data

Create a private booking link for an event type — single-use by default, or valid for a number of uses or until a date. Useful for sending one client a link to a hidden event type.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `event_type_id` | integer | Yes | Event type id, as shown by list_event_types. |
| `max_usage_count` | integer | No | Number of bookings the link allows (default 1). |
| `expires_at` | string | No | Valid until this date "YYYY-MM-DD" (end of day) or datetime, in time_zone. |
| `time_zone` | string | No | IANA time zone used to read and show times, e.g. "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur". Default: the time zone in your Cal profile. |

### `delete_private_link`

**Delete a private link** · access `bookings` · destructive — needs `confirm: true`

Revoke a private booking link so it can no longer be used. Needs confirm: true.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `event_type_id` | integer | Yes | Event type id, as shown by list_event_types. |
| `link_id` | string | Yes | Link id from list_private_links. |
| `confirm` | boolean | No | Must be true. Set it only after the user has explicitly confirmed this action. |

## Availability schedules

### `list_schedules`

**List availability schedules** · access `read` · read-only

Your availability schedules (working hours) with their time zone, weekly hours and upcoming date overrides; the default one is marked.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | `markdown` \| `json` | No | Output format: "markdown" (default, readable) or "json" (structured data). |

### `get_schedule`

**Get an availability schedule** · access `read` · read-only

One availability schedule (default: your default schedule) with weekly hours and date overrides.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `schedule_id` | integer | No | Schedule id, as shown by list_schedules. |
| `format` | `markdown` \| `json` | No | Output format: "markdown" (default, readable) or "json" (structured data). |

### `create_schedule`

**Create an availability schedule** · access `full` · changes data

Create a new availability schedule. Without availability it starts as Monday–Friday 09:00–17:00.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | Yes | Name, e.g. "Consulting hours". |
| `time_zone` | string | No | IANA time zone of the hours. Default: your profile time zone. |
| `availability` | { days, start_time, end_time }[] | No | Weekly working hours; several blocks per day are allowed (e.g. a lunch break). Replaces the existing hours. |
| `overrides` | { date, start_time, end_time }[] | No | Different hours on specific dates. Use block_dates to make a whole day unavailable. |
| `is_default` | boolean | No | Make it your default schedule (default false). |

### `update_schedule`

**Update an availability schedule** · access `full` · changes data (safe to repeat)

Change working hours or date overrides of a schedule (default: your default schedule). availability replaces the weekly hours; overrides are merged by date unless overrides_mode is "replace"; block_dates makes whole days unavailable and unblock_dates removes the overrides of those days.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `schedule_id` | integer | No | Schedule id (list_schedules). Default: your default schedule. |
| `name` | string | No | New name. |
| `time_zone` | string | No | New IANA time zone for the hours. |
| `availability` | { days, start_time, end_time }[] | No | Weekly working hours; several blocks per day are allowed (e.g. a lunch break). Replaces the existing hours. |
| `overrides` | { date, start_time, end_time }[] | No | Different hours on specific dates. Use block_dates to make a whole day unavailable. |
| `overrides_mode` | `merge` \| `replace` | No | merge (default): replace overrides only on the given dates; replace: overwrite all overrides. |
| `block_dates` | string[] | No | Days to make unavailable (e.g. holidays). |
| `unblock_dates` | string[] | No | Days whose overrides should be removed (back to weekly hours). |
| `is_default` | boolean | No | Make this your default schedule. |

### `delete_schedule`

**Delete an availability schedule** · access `full` · destructive — needs `confirm: true`

Delete a schedule that is not your default. Event types using it fall back to the default schedule. Needs confirm: true.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `schedule_id` | integer | Yes | Schedule id, as shown by list_schedules. |
| `confirm` | boolean | No | Must be true. Set it only after the user has explicitly confirmed this action. |

## Video apps & webhooks

### `list_conferencing_apps`

**Video apps** · access `read` · read-only

Installed video conferencing apps (Cal Video, Google Meet, Zoom, Teams …) and which one is the default for new bookings.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | `markdown` \| `json` | No | Output format: "markdown" (default, readable) or "json" (structured data). |

### `set_default_conferencing_app`

**Set default video app** · access `full` · changes data (safe to repeat)

Choose the video app used by default for new bookings. The app must already be installed in Cal.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `app` | `google-meet` \| `zoom` \| `msteams` \| `daily-video` | Yes | google-meet, zoom, msteams or daily-video (Cal Video). |

### `list_webhooks`

**List webhooks** · access `read` · read-only

Your webhooks (account-wide, or of one event type) with their triggers and target URL. Secrets are never shown.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `event_type_id` | integer | No | Event type id for event-type webhooks. Omit for account-wide webhooks. |
| `webhook_id` | integer | No | Show only this webhook. |
| `format` | `markdown` \| `json` | No | Output format: "markdown" (default, readable) or "json" (structured data). |

### `create_webhook`

**Create a webhook** · access `full` · changes data

Have Cal POST booking events to a URL — for all your bookings, or only one event type.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `subscriber_url` | string | Yes | HTTPS URL that receives the POST requests. |
| `triggers` | `BOOKING_CREATED` \| `BOOKING_PAYMENT_INITIATED` \| `BOOKING_PAID` \| `BOOKING_RESCHEDULED` \| `BOOKING_REQUESTED` \| `BOOKING_CANCELLED` \| `BOOKING_REJECTED` \| `BOOKING_NO_SHOW_UPDATED` \| `MEETING_STARTED` \| `MEETING_ENDED` \| `RECORDING_READY` \| `RECORDING_TRANSCRIPTION_GENERATED` \| `INSTANT_MEETING` \| `OOO_CREATED` \| `AFTER_HOSTS_CAL_VIDEO_NO_SHOW` \| `AFTER_GUESTS_CAL_VIDEO_NO_SHOW` \| `FORM_SUBMITTED` \| `FORM_SUBMITTED_NO_EVENT`[] | No | Default: ["BOOKING_CREATED", "BOOKING_RESCHEDULED", "BOOKING_CANCELLED"]. |
| `active` | boolean | No | Default true. |
| `secret` | string | No | Signing secret for the X-Cal-Signature-256 header. |
| `payload_template` | string | No | Custom payload template (Cal webhook variables). |
| `event_type_id` | integer | No | Event type id for event-type webhooks. Omit for account-wide webhooks. |

### `update_webhook`

**Update a webhook** · access `full` · changes data (safe to repeat)

Change a webhook: URL, triggers, active state, secret or payload template.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `webhook_id` | integer | Yes | Webhook id (list_webhooks). |
| `event_type_id` | integer | No | Event type id for event-type webhooks. Omit for account-wide webhooks. |
| `subscriber_url` | string | No |  |
| `triggers` | `BOOKING_CREATED` \| `BOOKING_PAYMENT_INITIATED` \| `BOOKING_PAID` \| `BOOKING_RESCHEDULED` \| `BOOKING_REQUESTED` \| `BOOKING_CANCELLED` \| `BOOKING_REJECTED` \| `BOOKING_NO_SHOW_UPDATED` \| `MEETING_STARTED` \| `MEETING_ENDED` \| `RECORDING_READY` \| `RECORDING_TRANSCRIPTION_GENERATED` \| `INSTANT_MEETING` \| `OOO_CREATED` \| `AFTER_HOSTS_CAL_VIDEO_NO_SHOW` \| `AFTER_GUESTS_CAL_VIDEO_NO_SHOW` \| `FORM_SUBMITTED` \| `FORM_SUBMITTED_NO_EVENT`[] | No | Events that fire the webhook, e.g. ["BOOKING_CREATED", "BOOKING_CANCELLED"]. |
| `active` | boolean | No |  |
| `secret` | string | No |  |
| `payload_template` | string | No |  |

### `delete_webhook`

**Delete a webhook** · access `full` · destructive — needs `confirm: true`

Delete a webhook. Needs confirm: true.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `webhook_id` | integer | Yes | Webhook id (list_webhooks). |
